origin.description: Mark selected functions in a functional sequence for debugging.
origin.details: An index is invalid unless some argument is numeric and some argument is a position in the sequence. That failure is Index or indices invalid. Positions are 1-based. A fraction is not a valid position, but once another index is valid it is truncated toward zero when the function is selected.

translation.description: Mark selected functions in a functional sequence for debugging.
translation.details: If no index is numeric, or none equals a position from 1 through the length, the error is Index or indices invalid. A non-sequence is rejected only after a numeric index is seen. On success the chosen functions are marked and the result is None.
translation.example:
from magrittr._fseq import FSeq
from magrittr.fseq import debug_fseq
debug_fseq(FSeq([lambda x: x]), 1)
